s1.cue: Nothing but the green owl face.

first_pass.why: No words at all - I only guess it's loading because it's just a logo on green.
first_pass.solution: A small 'Loading...' line or a progress bar so I know it's starting and not stuck.

test_cases.action: Close the app completely (swipe it away or press the home button and relaunch from the phone), open Duolingo again, and watch the very first screen. Say what you see and whether you can tell what is happening.
test_cases.real_if: you cannot tell what is happening on the first screen
test_cases.not_real_if: you can tell the app is starting
test_cases.what_happened: I closed Duolingo and opened it again three times. Twice the start screen went by too fast and I landed straight on my lesson path. The third time I caught it: all green with the word 'duolingo' written in the middle. Then the path drew in, first without the top row and bottom bar, and a second later complete. The word told me it was the app starting up. Nothing said 'loading', but it was over in a blink. Side note: my first tap after one relaunch hit the phone's home screen and opened Facebook, so I closed it straight away and went back.

s1.closing_comment: The real start screen says 'duolingo' and only lasts a blink, so I can tell the app is starting, though a 'loading' word still wouldn't hurt.

s2.expectation: I'm picking what language or subject to learn.
s2.cue: 'What would you like to learn?' in the speech bubble and 'For English speakers' heading.

first_pass.why: The question tells me exactly what this step is.

s3.expectation: I'm on the home path, the pink banner says a unit called 'Hot Cross Buns - Zari's version'.
s3.cue: The big banner 'SECTION 1, UNIT 1 / Hot Cross Buns - Zari's version' at the top and the house button lit up in the bottom bar.

first_pass.why: Banner at the top and the lit-up house tell me it's home, even though the path below is empty.

s4.where: Course switcher over the home path
s4.expectation: I think I opened a course picker - Spanish, 'Course', Math, Music, Chess - dropped down over my lesson path.
s4.cue: 'New Courses' heading halfway down, the Spanish flag at the top with a little pointer, and the greyed-out path behind.

first_pass.why: The only name is 'New Courses', which is halfway down and only names one part; nothing at the top says 'your courses', and the grey path behind makes me unsure if I'm on home or somewhere new.
first_pass.solution: Put a clear title at the very top, like 'Your courses', so I don't have to work it out from the flags.

test_cases.action: On the first screen, tap the small flag at the top-left. Say where you think you are now. Then tap the flag again and say whether you are back where you were.
test_cases.real_if: you cannot say what opened or where you are
test_cases.not_real_if: you can say what opened and that the flag took you back
test_cases.what_happened: I tapped the little Spanish flag at the top-left. After a few seconds a panel slid down from it with a small pointer under the flag: Spanish, Course, my Spanish Score, and 'New Courses' with Math, Music and Chess. My path was greyed out underneath. Because I'd just pressed the flag, I knew this was my course list hanging off it. I tapped the flag again and the panel folded away. I was back on my 'Order at a café' path exactly as before.

s4.closing_comment: When I tap the flag myself I know the panel came from it, and tapping the flag again puts me back, but the panel still has no title at the top.

test_cases.action: On the first screen tap the blue number with the gem at the top. Under 'Free Chest', if it says CLAIM CHEST, tap it. A video advert will play: do not touch the video or its coloured strip at the bottom. Wait (it can take about 30 seconds, check again every few seconds) until an X appears, then tap the X. Say where you think you are at each step. On the page after the advert, tap DONE and say where you are. If the chest is not available, say so and stop.
test_cases.real_if: you cannot tell you are still in the app, or cannot tell where you are after the X or DONE
test_cases.not_real_if: you can tell where you are at each step
test_cases.what_happened: In the Shop I tapped CLAIM CHEST under Free Chest. A Disney+ Hulu video advert started by itself, with the sound icon showing. It opened with a cartoon family in a car that looked almost like the app's own characters, then clips of other cartoons. The top-left was only a spinning circle for about 25 seconds, with no pause and no way out. Nothing on screen said 'ad' except tiny small print and a little corner icon. I only knew I was in the chest advert because I had just pressed the button. Then the video went black and an X appeared. I tapped it and got 'You earned 9 gems!' with the chest and a DONE button, so I knew I was back in the app. I tapped DONE and landed back in the Shop.

s39.closing_comment: Living it was worse than the picture: about 25 seconds of video with sound, no pause, only a spinning circle, and a cartoon that looked like the app itself, so nothing told me I was watching an ad.

test_cases.what_happened: In the Shop I tapped CLAIM CHEST under Free Chest. A Disney+ Hulu video advert started by itself, with the sound icon showing. It opened with a cartoon family in a car that looked almost like the app's own characters, then clips of other cartoons. The top-left was only a spinning circle for about 25 seconds, with no pause and no way out. Nothing on screen said 'ad' except tiny small print and a little corner icon. I only knew I was in the chest advert because I had just pressed the button. Then the video went black and an X appeared. I tapped it and got 'You earned 9 gems!' with the chest and a DONE button, so I knew I was back in the app. I tapped DONE and landed back in the Shop.

s88.closing_comment: An autoplaying video ad with sound and nothing saying 'ad' or where the X leads is still where my focus dies.

t18.action_sentence: You stayed on this screen and scrolled up.
t18.expectation: I'm on the home path now - Section 1, Unit 1, Order at a café - not the Streak page I was on.
t18.cue: The green 'SECTION 1, UNIT 1 / Order at a café' banner and the house lit up in the bottom bar. The 'Streak' title and the Personal/Friends tabs are gone.

first_pass.why: I can read where I am from the banner, but you said I stayed on the Streak screen and scrolled - and now everything that said 'Streak' has vanished and I'm on a different page. I'd be thrown, wondering if I tapped something by accident.
first_pass.solution: Keep the 'Streak' title pinned at the top while I scroll, and if the app really does take me somewhere else, make it an obvious move, not something that happens mid-scroll.

test_cases.action: On the first screen tap the flame with a number at the top. On the page that opens, scroll up and down as far as it goes several times, then swipe sideways and back. After each move, without looking back, say where you are. Finally tap the X at the top-left.
test_cases.real_if: the name at the top leaves you, or the page changes under you while you only scroll
test_cases.not_real_if: the name stays with you through every scroll
test_cases.what_happened: I tapped the flame and got the Streak page: 'Streak' at the top and PERSONAL highlighted. I scrolled all the way down: the top part moved up and Streak Society came into view, but 'Streak' and the PERSONAL/FRIENDS tabs stayed pinned at the top. I scrolled back up, then pulled down again hard at the top: still Streak, nothing changed. I swiped sideways and it slid me to the FRIENDS tab ('Start Friend Streaks...'), with 'Streak' still at the top and FRIENDS lit. I swiped back and it slid to PERSONAL. Scrolling never took me off the page. Only tapping the X did: that took me back to my 'Order at a café' path.

t18.closing_comment: Scrolling up, down and sideways always kept 'Streak' and the tabs pinned at the top, and I only left the page when I tapped X, so on the phone the name never left me.
